evidence: Removes CMake configure-time probes for Windows thread naming, drops MSVCRT from Nix cross-compilation tooling, and updates build documentation.
rationale: Cleans up temporary compatibility measures after branching 33.x and documents the MinGW-w64 12.0 requirement. As the author notes, this is 'a follow-up reverting #36057, now that we've branched off for 33.x' to eliminate an obsolete probe and remove legacy MSVCRT cross-compilation logic.
